tracks.name: AI Systems
tracks.description: Training, serving and evaluating machine-learning systems.

tracks.name: Data Infrastructure

talks.title: Quantized inference without the hype
talks.speaker: Rosa Ruiz
talks.abstract: A hands-on look at quantized inference, with code and real measurements. We compare three approaches and explain the trade-offs we accepted. Last year a similar session drew roughly 52 people.

talks.title: LLM evaluation harnesses without the hype
talks.speaker: Kemi Petrov
talks.abstract: This talk walks through how our team approached LLM evaluation harnesses over the past year. We compare three approaches and explain the trade-offs we accepted. Last year a similar session drew roughly 35 people.

talks.title: Rethinking collaborative editing

talks.abstract: We share the mistakes we made with collaborative editing and how we fixed them. We compare three approaches and explain the trade-offs we accepted. Organizers of past editions told us to plan for around 35 people.
